utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still only hearing bits and pieces, so I’d appreciate any update you find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll skim the notice and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too in case I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and check the donated parts, then I’ll send you anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. That leaves the parts list and final check—send over anything missing, and we’ll wrap up the rest once I see it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll do the final check and send you anything that’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — the bins are by the front table; start with the hardware pile and flag anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll start with the hardware pile and keep an eye out for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you — if you find anything unusual, just set it aside and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the community center parking lot, then head to the busiest spot after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll go from the community center parking lot to the busiest spot next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — that should cover both stops for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — just let me know what you need once you’ve checked, and I can bring the right tools or help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check the exact list and timing, then I’ll let you know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — just send me the list and timing when you have it, and I’ll bring whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I probably missed the latest update, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah—please set the sign-up at the community center parking lot and check the tools list. We still need tool kits and spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll set the sign-up at the community center parking lot and make sure tool kits and spare batteries are on the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll start with the boxes near the table and keep an eye out for anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that should keep things moving. I’m just making sure the drop-off list and spare parts stay in order, so I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem — I’ll keep at the boxes and holler if I spot anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask a few neighbors to help out, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. I’ll also remind folks to bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve been hearing the updates second-hand, so that really helps. I’ll keep passing it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and asking a few neighbors to help out. I’ll also remind everyone to bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — just send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll keep an eye on what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m pulling my notes together now and I’ll send the missing items over in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll be here and keep track of the remaining supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — it’s still happening today around 3 PM, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today at 3 PM. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll plan on 3 PM today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start spreading the word right away. I can also help check on volunteers if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the details over right now. If you can, checking on volunteers would be a huge help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — send them over and I’ll get right on it, plus I’ll check in on volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and report back if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’s really helpful. Let me know what you find when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll stop by on my way and let you know if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring a Phillips screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’ll be really helpful. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at the community center on Maple Street works for me. Just let me know if you need help with the drop-off or carrying anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Pia — I’ll spread the word and line up a few helpers for Saturday morning at the community center on Maple Street. I’ll also make sure the pickup time gets shared so everything’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — please send me the pickup time when you have it, and I can help with the drop-off if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — 3 PM works best. I’ll confirm who’s available and send the update right after.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. I’ll plan on 3 PM then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll check who’s available now and send the update as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on the list, Hana, but I’ll let you know as soon as I know what’s needed and by when.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll hold off until you’ve got the list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — thank you. Let’s start with the tools and note anything worn, and remember the drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll sort the tools, set aside anything worn, and bring the screwdriver set and gloves on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — that’s exactly what we need. I’ll keep the list updated, and we’ll meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I can sort supplies and help with house checks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Rey—please take both, and I’ll put you on the list for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday and get started on both.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — I’ll ask around and let you know what’s still needed. We’re getting close, I think, thanks to everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an ear out and keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and let you know as soon as I hear what’s still needed. We’re definitely making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort supplies this afternoon, quietly. Just let me know what you need, and I’ll keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — can you sort the supplies this afternoon, and would a quiet call later today work to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I can sort the supplies this afternoon, and a quiet call later today should work too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll come by around 9 on Saturday and bring the tools. If you need a reminder of the plan, I can help with that too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — 9 on Saturday works great. Just bring the tools, and I’ll have the driveway cleared for us.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll see you at 9 on Saturday with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and ready to unload and sort.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Eli — Saturday at 9 works well. I’ll come by after school pickup and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check my notes and bring what I can — tools, tape, nails, and any spare wood. If I find labels too, I’ll add those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that covers most of it — I’ll keep the supplies list updated and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring what I find and send any missing items after I check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—just give me a shout if anything else comes up before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Sam—see you at the repair drive, and I’ll shout if anything changes!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess—see you there, and I’ll be ready with the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can come by right after school pickup and help with the repair drive. If you have the tools ready, that should make it nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds perfect, Faye — I’ll have the tools ready right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ll head over right after pickup.
